title: Terraform module for idempotent Private EKS control-plane: preflight inspector + rolling sanity hooks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a reusable Terraform module (redwood/priv-eks-controlplane) that provides idempotent, auditable provisioning of the Private EKS control plane with an opinionated preflight inspector, rollout canary toggles, and automated rolling-sanity health hooks. Goals: (1) Make cluster control-plane provisioning deterministic and safe to re-run from CI/CD; (2) Provide a preflight validation phase that surfaces networking/KMS/iam mismatches before any mutation; (3) Add lightweight post-provisioning probes and continuous control-plane health checks that integrate with Console alerts; (4) Support an opt-in immutable deploy mode and an in-place rolling upgrade mode with canary nodes and automatic rollback on probe failures. The module should be composable by our provisioner operator and support both self-managed on-prem and AWS VPC variants via flags.
